_comment: KOMBI (instrument cluster) READ-ONLY diagnostic trace for a BMW R18-class
modern cluster, reconstructed from MotoScan 1.110 bytecode (de.wgsoft.motoscan,
ADDRESSING [APK]: tester 0x6F1, KOMBI ECU address byte 0x60 (cr.smali cr.c(I),
const 0x60 before the cluster switch). ELM protocol-B extended addressing, so the
physical response CAN id is 0x660 and frames carry an address-extension byte.
mc0.t1 = 22 F1 50). The EXPECTED response bytes here are [INFERRED] illustrative
shapes consistent with sl0.r()'s documented length/field parsing (E119 7-byte
incl. 3-byte header + 4-byte big-endian odometer; E12B 10-byte; E12D 5-byte with
a 2-byte big-endian short at offset 3; E12C 7-byte day/month/year). They are NOT
a real R18 capture and must be replaced with a verified capture before any claim.
This trace contains NO write. It is safe to replay offline.
name: kombi-read-r18

steps.note: ECU probe 22 F1 50; positive prefix 62 F1 50 (mc0.t1 / sl0.o0). Response payload INFERRED.
odometer read; request [APK]; response [INFERRED] 4-byte BE at offset 3 = 123456
clock read; request [APK]; response [INFERRED] 7 data bytes
service-distance read; request [APK]; response [INFERRED] 2-byte BE short
